cards.ex: If you want the inside scoop, you need to be in the know.
cards.exUz: Agar ichki ma'lumotni bilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, xabardor bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsadan yaxshi xabardor bo'lish, ma'lumotga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's a common misconception that all snakes are venomous.
cards.exUz: Hamma ilonlar zaharli degan noto'g'ri tushuncha keng tarqalgan.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik noto'g'ri deb biladigan, ammo keng tarqalgan tushuncha.

cards.ex: The rules on data privacy are still a bit of a grey area.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar maxfiyligi qoidalari hali ham biroz noaniq soha.
cards.uzDef: Aniq qoidalar yoki tushunchalar bo'lmagan noaniq holat.

cards.ex: Sometimes, I think she lives in a state of blissful ignorance about the world's problems.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, u dunyo muammolaridan baxtiyor bexabarlikda yashaydi deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Muammolardan bexabar bo'lishdan kelib chiqadigan baxt.

cards.ex: I'm at a loss to explain why the computer isn't working.
cards.exUz: Nima uchun kompyuter ishlamayotganini tushuntirishga ojizman.
cards.uzDef: Nima deyish yoki qilishni bilmaslik, chalkashib qolish.

cards.ex: You need to have a basic knowledge of accounting to understand this report.
cards.exUz: Bu hisobotni tushunish uchun sizda buxgalteriya hisobi bo'yicha asosiy bilim bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida umumiy, minimal tushunchaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of everything he claims to believe in.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari uning e'tiqod qilaman degan hamma narsasiga zid.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan e'tiqod yoki amaliyotga zid bo'lish.

cards.ex: There's a widespread belief that organic food is healthier.
cards.exUz: Organik oziq-ovqat sog'lomroq degan keng tarqalgan e'tiqod bor.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik odamlar tomonidan qabul qilingan e'tiqod.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you start using this software.
cards.exUz: Ushbu dasturiy ta'minotni ishlatishni boshlaganingizda tik o'rganish egri chizig'i bor.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganish uchun kerak bo'ladigan vaqt va harakat.

cards.ex: Some people practice deliberate ignorance to avoid facing difficult truths.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar qiyin haqiqatlarga duch kelmaslik uchun ongli befarqlikni mashq qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani bilishdan ataylab qochish.

cards.ex: The evidence confirmed my suspicions about his involvement.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning ishtiroki haqidagi gumonlarimni tasdiqladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan gumon qilganingizni isbotlash.

cards.ex: I don't have a clue how to fix this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni qanday hal qilishni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida hech qanday bilimi yo'qligi, tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: Eventually, people will get wise to their tricks.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, odamlar ularning hiylalarini tushunishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani tushunish yoki bilish, ayniqsa avvalgi aldovdan keyin.

cards.ex: He's a known quantity; we know what to expect from him.
cards.exUz: U ma'lum miqdor; undan nimani kutishimizni bilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri tanish bo'lgan va oldindan aytib bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way that you can't trust everyone.
cards.exUz: U hamma odamga ishonib bo'lmasligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Xatoliklar qilib va ulardan saboq olib o'rganish.

cards.ex: She has a wealth of knowledge about the history of art.
cards.exUz: Uning san'at tarixi haqida bilim boyligi bor.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdordagi bilim va tajriba.

cards.ex: You should take what he says with a grain of salt; he tends to exaggerate.
cards.exUz: Uning gaplarini biroz shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak; u mubolag'a qilishga moyil.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmaslik, biroz shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The complexity of quantum physics is beyond my comprehension.
cards.exUz: Kvant fizikasi murakkabligi mening tushunishimdan tashqari.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish qobiliyatidan tashqari murakkab yoki g'alati.

cards.ex: He lacks understanding of the social issues involved.
cards.exUz: U tegishli ijtimoiy masalalarni tushunmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida yetarli bilimi yo'qligi.

cards.ex: When she saw them together, she put two and two together.
cards.exUz: Ularni birga ko'rganida, u ikkitani ikkiga qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarni birlashtirib, xulosaga kelish.

cards.ex: That's a common belief within that school of thought.
cards.exUz: Bu fikr maktabida keng tarqalgan e'tiqod.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan mavzu bo'yicha o'xshash g'oyalarga ega bo'lgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: He's living in a fool's paradise if he thinks she'll forgive him.
cards.exUz: Agar u uni kechiradi deb o'ylasa, u ahmoq jannatida yashayapti.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri e'tiqod asosida baxtiyorlik holati.

cards.ex: There was a dawning realization in his eyes that he'd made a mistake.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'zlarida xato qilganini asta-sekin anglash boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani asta-sekin tushunish.

cards.ex: The research confirmed what I thought all along.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotlar men doim o'ylagan narsani tasdiqladi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan o'ylagan fikrni tasdiqlovchi dalil topish.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to their own point of view.
cards.exUz: Har kim o'z nuqtai nazariga ega bo'lish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga qarash yoki fikr bildirish usuli.

cards.ex: In my estimation, he's the best candidate for the job.
cards.exUz: Mening bahoimda, u ish uchun eng yaxshi nomzod.
cards.uzDef: Mening shaxsiy fikrimcha, men ishonaman.

cards.ex: I lost the thread of the conversation when they started talking about politics.
cards.exUz: Ular siyosat haqida gapira boshlaganlarida, men suhbat ipini yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Nutqdagi, hikoyadagi yoki argumentdagi asosiy nuqtani yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I have a nagging doubt about whether we made the right decision.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri qaror qabul qildikmi yo'qmi degan tinch bermaydigan shubham bor.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz va doimiy shubha.

cards.ex: You need to take his age into account when evaluating his performance.
cards.exUz: Uning ishlashini baholashda uning yoshini hisobga olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani ko'rib chiqish yoki esda tutish.

cards.ex: In retrospect, I should have listened to my mother's advice.
cards.exUz: Orqaga nazar tashlab, onamning maslahatiga quloq solishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga nazar tashlab, nima sodir bo'lganini tushunish.
